d:
Maharashtr men raygarh zile ke karjat men rahne vale log aur paryavran karyakarta torent pavar ke panp storej projekt ke lie peron ki kataee ka virodh kar rahe hain. unka kahna hai ki isse jangal, jangli janavron, turizm aur sthaniy jal sansadhnon ko nuksan ho sakta hai.
Halanki, maharashtr ke mukhyamantri devendr phadanvis ne is projekt ko klin enarji ki pahal bataya hai. unhonne kaha hai ki iske badle per lagae jaenge.
Sthaniy log aur paryavran karyakartaon ki mang hai ki jab tak unki chintaon ka hal nahin ho jata, peron ki kataee roki jae.
Riport aur shut: janhavi mule
